text:
alex: Heads-up: promotion is blocked. postsubmit `bundle-upload` is failing repeatedly with 504s when PUTting the frontend bundle. deploy-bot auto-paused the promotion.

deploy-bot: Promotion auto-paused: artifact upload error (504 Gateway Timeout)  attempts=5/5  state=hold

maya: Which artifact and which region? Can we retry against another endpoint?

alex: frontend bundle `bundle-frontend-2026.3.4.tgz` from eu-west builder. Runners hit 504 during the multipart PUT finalization.

ryan: CI logs snippet:
```
ERROR: multipart upload failed: 504 Gateway Timeout
client -> storage-eu-west.company.net: timeout during PUT /uploads/abcd1234
```

ryan: Also seeing exponential backoff causing long CI queue hold times.

sre-oncall: I'm seeing elevated 504 rate from storage frontends. Opening infra incident and paging the storage team now (#infra-7892). ETA unknown.

alex: Decision needed: (A) wait for storage fix (B) manual promote last good artifact (C) abort release. We have a 1hr change window.

maya: Waiting could exhaust runner quotas. Recommend (B): manual promote previous SHA `sha:cc33dd44` which passed staging smoke. Then reattempt new bundle in next window.

ryan: +1 for manual promote. We should also capture telemetry and mark the build as blocked to avoid retries consuming credits.

deploy-bot: Manual promote request queued by @maya. To run: `/deploybot promote --sha cc33dd44 --env prod --reason "artifact upload 504, manual pin"`

alex: I'll run the promote now and append a note in the release doc: "Promotion paused due to storage 504s during artifact upload; manual promote to previously verified sha:cc33dd44 to keep change window."

sre-oncall: Storage team acknowledged and started a rolling config change; they reported transient proxy overload. ETA 15-30m for stabilization. Ticket #infra-7892.

deploy-bot: Promotion completed: sha cc33dd44 promoted to prod at 2026-03-24T09:20:12Z. No immediate errors reported.

alex: Monitoring traffic and error rates - so far clean. Next steps: (1) infra postmortem + storage mitigation plan; (2) re-upload new artifact once infra green; (3) coordinate a targeted canary for the new bundle in next change window.

maya: I'll OWN the re-upload and coordinate with storage on a retry plan (use reduced concurrency + multipart chunk size change). Updating release notes and pinging PMs. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: Logged incident summary to incidents channel and linked infra ticket. Will follow up with storage after their rollout.
